extracted.name: Butter Pecan Cookies
extracted.description: These soft pecan cookies get their flavor from butter, brown sugar, and toasted pecan halves for a delicious nutty treat perfect for the holidays.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
instruction_lines: Beat butter, brown sugar, and egg together in a large bowl until well blended. Slowly add flour and salt; mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheets. Flatten balls with the bottom of a glass dipped in flour. Press a pecan into the top of each dough ball.
Bake in the preheated oven until sides are golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes.
